name: MonarchCalendarToolbar
title: CalendarToolbar
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow with MonarchButton, androidx.compose.material3.IconButton, androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu and MonarchProgress
summary: The header of a calendar: Today, previous and next, the range title with a busy indicator, a menu that switches between day, week, month and agenda views, and the app's actions.
whenToUse: Above a calendar, agenda or booking grid that moves through ranges of dates and offers more than one view.
whenNotToUse: For a month picker on its own use MonarchMiniMonth, which has its own arrows. For a screen title with actions use a Material 3 TopAppBar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCalendarToolbar(title: String, view: MonarchCalendarToolbarView, onToday: () -> Unit, onPrevious: () -> Unit, onNext: () -> Unit, previousIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, nextIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, views: List<MonarchCalendarToolbarView> = MonarchCalendarToolbarView.entries, onViewChange: ((MonarchCalendarToolbarView) -> Unit)? = null, busy: Boolean = false, todayEnabled: Boolean = true, previousEnabled: Boolean = true, nextEnabled: Boolean = true, viewMenuIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchCalendarToolbarLabels = MonarchCalendarToolbarLabels(), actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchCalendarToolbarView { Day, Week, Month, Agenda }

class MonarchCalendarToolbarLabels(today: String? = null, previous: ((String) -> String)? = null, next: ((String) -> String)? = null, view: String? = null, viewName: ((MonarchCalendarToolbarView) -> String)? = null, unit: ((MonarchCalendarToolbarView) -> String)? = null, loading: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The range shown, already formatted: "November 2026", "2 – 8 Nov 2026". A heading, announced when it changes.

options.name: view
options.description: The current view. It names the arrows for its unit and is marked in the switcher.

options.name: onToday
options.description: Moves to the range that contains today.

options.name: onPrevious
options.description: Moves back one unit of the view.

options.name: onNext
options.description: Moves forward one unit of the view.

options.name: previousIcon
options.description: The backward chevron. Monarch bundles no icons; mirror it right to left.

options.name: nextIcon
options.description: The forward chevron, mirrored right to left.

options.name: views
options.description: The views offered, in order. With one view or none the switcher is not shown.

options.name: onViewChange
options.description: Called with the chosen view. Without it the switcher is not shown.

options.name: busy
options.description: Shows a small circular progress indicator, named "Loading", after the title.

options.name: todayEnabled
options.description: Turn off when the range already contains today.

options.name: previousEnabled
options.description: Turn off at the start of a booking window.

options.name: nextEnabled
options.description: Turn off at the end of a booking window.

options.name: viewMenuIcon
options.description: A decorative trailing icon of the switcher button, such as a down chevron.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Today", "Previous week", "Next week", "Calendar view", the view names, the units and "Loading".

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls at the end: a New event button, a filter menu, a date picker button.

states.name: one line
states.description: Today, the arrows, the title, then the switcher and actions, when they fit.

states.name: wrapped
states.description: When one line does not fit, the parts wrap onto further lines; a long title wraps inside its own line.

states.name: busy
states.description: A small circular progress indicator after the title; with animations removed it is still.

states.name: disabled controls
states.description: Today and either arrow can be disabled; they take the disabled text color and do not call back.

states.name: menu open
states.description: A Material 3 dropdown menu lists the views, the current one with a selected radio button.

appearance: Today is a secondary MonarchButton, the arrows are icon buttons in the default text color (the disabled text color when off), the title uses the subheading style in the default text color and the switcher is a small secondary button. The menu takes the theme's raised surface. High contrast themes use their stronger borders and text.
platformNotes: The web shows a segmented control for the views; on a phone width four segments next to the navigation do not fit, so Android uses a menu button, as iOS does, and the segmented control stays available as SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow for apps with room. The web's titleAs (heading level) is heading semantics. The web's datePicker slot is part of actions. The web accepts product-defined view ids; this enum has the four built-in views. The web's chevron glyphs are required icon slots because Monarch bundles no icons. iOS builds the same component with the same name.
accessibility: The title has heading semantics and is a polite live region, so TalkBack announces the new range after an arrow is pressed.
The arrows are named for the view's unit ("Previous week", "Next month") and have 48dp touch targets.
The switcher is named "Calendar view" with the current view as its state description; in the menu the current view has the selected state and a radio button.
Every control has a touch target of at least 48 by 48dp; at the largest font size the parts wrap instead of being cut.
edgeCases: A long title wraps on its own line instead of pushing the controls off screen.
With views set to one view the switcher is hidden, but that view still names the arrows.
Choosing the view that is already current closes the menu without calling onViewChange.
The title is announced on every change, including the app's own; set it once per move.

examples.title: Month view with actions
examples.template:
MonarchCalendarToolbar(
    title = {{title}},
    view = view,
    onToday = {},
    onPrevious = {},
    onNext = {},
    previousIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronLeft, contentDescription = null) },
    nextIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
    views = listOf(
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.{{views.0|pascal}},
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.{{views.1|pascal}},
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.{{views.2|pascal}},
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.{{views.3|pascal}},
    ),
    onViewChange = { view = it },
    todayEnabled = !{{todayDisabled}},
    actions = {
        MonarchButton(
            text = {{action.label}},
            onClick = {},
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{action.variant|pascal}},
            size = MonarchButtonSize.{{action.size|pascal}},
        )
    },
)
examples.code:
MonarchCalendarToolbar(
    title = "November 2026",
    view = view,
    onToday = {},
    onPrevious = {},
    onNext = {},
    previousIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronLeft, contentDescription = null) },
    nextIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
    views = listOf(
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.Day,
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.Week,
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.Month,
        MonarchCalendarToolbarView.Agenda,
    ),
